name: 4th Guwahati Open 2018

venue.name: Cotton University
venue.details: Sudmersen Hall, physics department, Cotton University. The hall is opposite of BSNL head office, Panbazar.

information: There is on-spot registration. Please bring your ID cards for identification at the venue. We have a competitor limit of 130 participants which will be filled on First come basis. Registration closes either on 28 August 2018, 23:59. IST or when registration count reaches 130 (whichever comes first)
